name: Go implementation
description: Implements a requested Go change while preserving API, lifecycle, and repository constraints.

steps.instruction: Translate the request into observable acceptance criteria. Inspect module versions, call sites, interfaces, errors, tests, configuration, and repository conventions before choosing an API.
Implement the smallest cohesive design with explicit dependencies, bounded resource use, caller context propagation, safe zero values, and compatibility at public or serialized boundaries.

Add behavior-focused tests for success and important failures, format touched files, and run exactly `go test ./...` plus exactly `go vet ./...`. Use race, integration, or benchmark checks when the change creates those risks.
